(Getty Images) Summary * Hunter Biden plans to launch LAPTOP, a one-billion-token memecoin on Coinbase’s Base network, with founders receiving 30 percent of the supply and another 20 percent allocated to airdrops. * Wallets that lost money on President Donald Trump’s TRUMP token will be among the first eligible for an airdrop, while Biden’s Substack subscribers and a mailing list associated with journalist Andrew Callaghan will also receive tokens. * Crypto traders sharply criticized the launch, prompting Kraken to delete a promotional post and Callaghan and a Coinbase Base executive to distance themselves from the project. Hunter Biden will launch a memecoin called LAPTOP on Wednesday, and the crypto traders it is designed to attract are telling him not to bother. The token deploys on Base, the network Coinbase built, with a supply of one billion. Founders including Biden take 30%, locked for six months and released over more than two years. Another 20% goes out in two airdrops, and the first group in line is wallets sitting on losses from TRUMP, the memecoin Donald Trump launched days before his 2025 inauguration. The move comes as authorities widen their investigation into the collapse of the exchange. Zondacrypto was founded as BitBay back in 2014, and had more than 1 million registered users when it [rebranded in 2021.](https://www.coindesk.com/business/2021/11/08/polands-largest-crypto-exchange-revamps-to-go-license-shopping) Roman Ż. is at least the fifth person to be charged since prosecutors folded the case into the inquiry into Suszek's disappearance.
